blocks.text: Merge complete scaled BA deltas; separately averaging factors creates cross-terms that were never trained. The task is: Merge weighted LoRA deltas into an independent base-weight tensor. Each adapter is (A[r,in],B[out,r],alpha); compute sum coefficient*(alpha/r)*B@A. Different ranks are supported. Do not multiply separately averaged A/B matrices.

The inputs are `base`, `adapters`, `weights`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
